# HimachalLand Check

> An independent, bilingual land-record research and buyer-education service for Himachal Pradesh, India. It is not a government website and does not issue certified records or legal opinions.

## Primary topics

- Jamabandi, khasra, khatauni and khewat terminology
- Mutation (intkal) history and pre-purchase document checks
- Tatima / cadastral-map viewing guidance
- Mortgage, registered-deed, land-use and Section 118 verification guidance
- Himachal Pradesh land-area conversion and buyer checklists

## Preferred pages

- English home: /en
- Hindi home: /hi
- English tools: /en/tools
- Hindi tools: /hi/tools
- English verification workspace: /en/verify
- Hindi verification workspace: /hi/verify
- English buyer guide: /en/blog/7-documents-before-buying-land
- Hindi buyer guide: /hi/blog/7-documents-before-buying-land

## Source and safety policy

- Official Himachal Pradesh and Indian court/registration portals are linked for final verification.
- Demo records and map examples are fictional and clearly labelled.
- Personal record pages, dashboards, login pages and APIs are not intended for indexing.
- Users must verify records with the relevant Patwari, Tehsil, Sub-Registrar or competent authority before a transaction.

## Languages

- English (en-IN)
- Hindi (hi-IN)
